summary: EQUATOR Beverage Co filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on July 1, 2026, solely to disclose a press release announcing its unaudited second-quarter 2026 results. Revenue grew 13% year-over-year to $1.25M and net income rose 30% to $199K. The filing contains no structural corporate event, no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, delisting, or other special-situation activity. It is a routine earnings release furnished under Regulation FD, not a material definitive agreement or binding transaction. No deal terms are applicable. The registrant remains the issuer of its common stock with no change in control or capital structure. No watch item or arbitrage angle arises.
